verdict.rationale: The docs say agent work can run on your own compute. The remote daemon host "can be a cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine", the marketing page offers to "run the HumanLayer stack on your workstation or remote workers", and there are documented install and launch-token guides plus `humanlayer automation run` for CI jobs and servers. Missing for 10: any explicit container or Docker deployment docs; clarity on whether the control plane (app.humanlayer.com) can be self-hosted rather than only the execution daemons; independent or hands-on corroboration.
